what: Hand verification of every auto-accepted critical field (offer price, MRP, pack) from the owner's real store photos and videos (docs/evidence/store_media.json), checked by eye against the source images on 2026-10-10.
source: 19 photos + 2 videos (12 keyframes) from hypermarket aisles, QSR menu boards, apparel and electronics displays in a Nagpur mall, sent on WhatsApp (2026-10-09). Two personal files (an airline check-in screen with a passenger's name, a social-media screenshot) were excluded before analysis.
pipeline: quality check -> OCR -> model read A -> targeted read B on doubtful critical fields -> fused value with confidence and a box on the source -> auto-accept at >= 0.90, everything else to a person

after_consistency_checks.unverifiable_reason: price tag cut off at the frame edge or text too small in a 464-px-wide WhatsApp video frame

errors_found_and_fixes.pattern: MRP read as equal to the smart price when the tiny MRP line was unreadable (Smart Bazaar tags: SMART PRICE 47, MRP 50, YOUR BACHAT 3)
errors_found_and_fixes.fix: if MRP equals the offer price and no MRP-labelled line on the source confirms it, the MRP goes to a person (extraction.sanity)

errors_found_and_fixes.pattern: placeholder text accepted as a value (pack = 'not specified')
errors_found_and_fixes.fix: placeholder text is treated as not found (extraction.sanity)

remaining_errors.truth: 402 is the shelf price of a neighbouring diaper pack; no MRP visible
pack size belongs to a different product on the same shelf
